description: This file contains implementation code for retrieving and managing Windows DNS system settings, including reading registry values, adapter DNS addresses, and DNS configuration details.

classes.name: RegistryReader
classes.description: Helper class for reading registry values (strings and DWORDs) from specified registry keys.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings
classes.description: Class encapsulating Windows DNS system settings, including DNS addresses, search lists, domain info, and devolution settings.

classes.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::DevolutionSetting
classes.description: Struct representing DNS devolution configuration with optional enabled and level parameters.

methods.name: ReadAdapterDnsAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves DNS server addresses from network adapters using GetAdaptersAddresses.

methods.name: ReadDevolutionSetting
methods.description: Reads DNS devolution settings from the registry.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::IsStatelessDiscoveryAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IPv6 address is a stateless discovery address based on its prefix.

methods.name: WinDnsSystemSettings::GetAllNameservers
methods.description: Returns all DNS nameserver endpoints from network adapters, filtering out stateless discovery addresses.

methods.name: ReadWinSystemDnsSettings
methods.description: Main function to read and assemble Windows DNS system settings from registry and network adapters.
